messages:
matt: Planning a blue/green switch for eu-west1 at 03:00 UTC tonight. Change window 03:00-04:00. Plan is staged weighted crossover from green -> blue (runtime:v2 -> runtime:v3). Canary has been running on 10 hosts for 6h.

matt: Preflight checklist: health checks = OK, key infra alerts clear, no DB migrations, model pinned to `runtime:v3-202603`, session-affinity TTL 2h, cookie pin enabled. I'll start the shift after +2 ACKs here.

sara: ACK. I'll be on metrics and traces.

jon: ACK. Quick ask — can we make the first two hold windows 3m instead of 5m? last run showed a short-lived p95 blip that settled in ~2m.

matt: fine. change windows now: 1% -> wait 3m; 5% -> wait 3m; 25% -> wait 5m; 50% -> wait 5m -> 100%.

lee: confirm session stickiness preserved during weight adjustments. Cookie TTL 2h ok for me.

tanya: adding rollback conditions: p95 latency +200ms vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% sustained across a 1m window. Also if 502s or 5xxs >0.3% for >2m, rollback.

ops-bot: Alert rule `router:response_5xx_rate` configured with threshold 0.3% (2m) and `router:p95_delta` set to 200ms.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: applying router weight change (green->blue) for service `api-router-eu`.

deploy-bot: STEP 1 -> set blue weight=1%, green weight=99% at 03:00:55 UTC.

sara: seeing small traffic to v3, 200s. p95 120ms, error rate 0.02% :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: STEP 2 -> set blue weight=5% at 03:04:02 UTC.

jon: slight p95 uptick to 150ms but within threshold. no errors.

deploy-bot: STEP 3 -> set blue weight=25% at 03:07:10 UTC.

matt: hold — I'm seeing 502s on /api/generate at 03:08:05 around 0.3% (spike). Investigating logs.

sara: logs show backend pool `gen-svc-v3` returning upstream 502s for a subset of requests. Stacktraces point to worker OOM on a narrow sequence length.

jon: that's borderline our rollback threshold for 5xx. tanya, agree we should roll back.

tanya: yes, initiate rollback. We'll pin runtime to v2 until we root cause. Disable auto-rollout.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK initiated at 03:09:20 UTC -> setting blue weight=0%, green weight=100%. Confirming in progress.

deploy-bot: ROUTER weights restored to green 100% at 03:09:45 UTC. Canary instances left running for debugging.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-245. Pager duty notified.

matt: noted. I've pinned `api-router-eu` to `runtime:v2-stable` in the router config and disabled scheduled progressive rollouts for this deploy.

lee: pushing a quick config snippet to keep for the postmortem:
```json
{"service":"api-router-eu","weights":{"green":"100%","blue":"0%"},"session_affinity_ttl":"2h","pinned_version":"runtime:v2-stable"}
```

sara: canary V3 hosts kept in debug mode, capturing heap + request payloads. We'll reproduce the OOM with a stress test later.

tanya: action items: (1) root cause OOM with sequences >2k tokens, (2) add worker memory guard for v3, (3) re-run canary with synthetic long sequences and warmup.

matt: re-open canary after fixes. For now rolling notes: rollback completed, pinned v2, incident INC-2026-245. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:

sara: I'll file a short postmortem draft and include CPU/mem traces.

jon: might be worth adding a warmup phase for v3 next run (pre-populate KV cache). I'll add that to the PR.

deploy-bot: Follow-up scheduled: canary retry window set for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

matt: good. Closing thread — will update when postmortem ready.
